summary: Reads transform data from a named shared memory block created by another TouchDesigner process with Shared Mem Out COMP, enabling cross-process object-transform sharing.

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Shared memory block name to read from

key_params.name: opviewer
key_params.note: Operator viewer used for node viewer when configured

key_params.name: enablecloning
key_params.note: Enable active cloning from a clone master

key_params.name: externaltox
key_params.note: External .tox source path for the component

key_params.name: relpath
key_params.note: Relative file path behavior for child file paths

key_concepts: Shared Mem In COMP reads transform data from a named shared memory block created by another TouchDesigner process.
The Shared Mem Name parameter must match the writer's shared memory block name exactly.
The operator is for transform exchange between processes, not arbitrary TOP, CHOP, or DAT data transfer.
Current docs note license availability for Educational, Commercial, and Pro, while also stating Commercial/Pro availability on the page.
Common COMP shortcut, node-viewer, clone, external-tox, and relative-path settings still apply because this is a component wrapper.
common_gotchas: Shared Mem In COMP requires TouchDesigner Educational, Commercial, or Pro according to current docs, and the page also notes Commercial/Pro availability.
The Shared Mem Name must exactly match the writer's name or no transform data will be read.
It reads transform data, not arbitrary TOP/CHOP/DAT payloads.
The source shared memory block must be created by another Touch process using Shared Mem Out COMP.
Coordinate and update timing between processes should be validated with Info CHOP/errors before relying on live transforms.
Name collisions across multiple processes can make the wrong transform stream appear to connect.
